summary: PureCycle Technologies filed an 8-K reporting the entry into an underwriting agreement for a registered offering of $287.5 million in 4.75% convertible senior notes due 2032. The offering included a $250 million initial tranche plus a $37.5 million over-allotment exercised in full. Morgan Stanley acted as representative of the underwriters. The notes are convertible into common stock, with customary lock-up agreements for insiders. While convertible offerings can signal capital structure changes, this is a standard debt capital markets transaction not fitting special-situation categories like restructuring or going-private. What to watch: dilution from conversion and note price performance post-close.
